stem: What does this list suggest about the drafters of the Articles of Confederation?

options.label: F
options.text: They did not want a judicial system based upon that of Great Britain.

options.label: G
options.text: They feared that a strong central government would abuse its power.

options.label: H
options.text: They were uncertain that democracy would continue to be the best type of government.

options.label: J
options.text: They did not think that state governments could provide for the general welfare.

visual_elements: Did not grant a federal power to tax or regulate commerce
Did not establish a common currency
Did not establish an executive or judicial branch
